title: Distance to Display Mapper
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics and Computational Thinking
description: Turn one distance reading into an OLED bar chart, an OLED meter, and a NeoPixel status color, and see how int(), min(bar_height, 50), and the 50 cm and 20 cm thresholds shape each output.

educational.topic: Mapping sensor readings to display outputs
learningObjectives: Predict the OLED bar height int(distance / max_cm * 50) for any distance and max_cm.
Predict the NeoPixel status color from the 50 cm and 20 cm thresholds.
Explain why min(bar_height, 50) keeps the bar inside its drawing area.
prerequisites: OLED drawing calls and NeoPixel colors (Chapter 9)

controls.label: Sweep / Stop
controls.purpose: Move the distance from 300 cm to 0 and back at 60 cm per second.

controls.label: Use min(bar_height, 50) clamp
controls.purpose: Turn the clamp in draw_distance_bar() on or off.

controls.label: Distance
controls.purpose: The distance reading fed to all three outputs.

controls.label: max_cm
controls.purpose: The distance that fills the 50-pixel bar.

simulationModel.modelType: Pixel-accurate display rendering of chapter code
equations: bar_height = min(bar_height, 50) when the clamp is on
status = green if distance > 50, yellow if distance > 20, else red
assumptions: The OLED is 128 x 64 pixels and each character is 8 x 8 pixels.
limitations: Glyphs come from a public-domain 8 x 8 font and may differ slightly from the MicroPython framebuf font.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, then check with a filled-in worked formula
pedagogical.interactionPattern: One slider drives three linked outputs and a formula box; optional sweep
keyQuestions: How tall is the bar at 50 cm, and why is it not 12.5?
Why is 50 cm yellow instead of green?
What would happen on the real OLED without min(bar_height, 50)?
commonMisconceptions: int() rounds to the nearest whole number.
A distance of exactly 50 cm counts as greater than 50.
A bar can never be drawn past the edge of its area.
assessmentOpportunities: Find the green-to-yellow distance and the bar height there.
Explain the bar overflow at 250 cm with max_cm 100 and no clamp.
Change a threshold so the LED is red at 25 cm.
